unit.why: An anthology of sources on charity (Zohar, Talmud, Tanna de-Vei Eliyahu, Rambam, Tanya and Iggeret ha-Kodesh, kavvanot for giving charity); it holds only brief embedded talmudic anecdotes, the fullest being R. Akiva's daughter.
unit.boundary_note: previous division ends a Hasidic story about a letter on charity; the next division begins a new story from רמ״ץ

stories.end_quote: נפיק ר״ע ודרש וצדקה תציל וגו׳
stories.summary_en: A talmudic anecdote, quoted in abbreviated form: astrologers foretold that R. Akiva's daughter would die of a snakebite on her wedding day, but she was saved because she had given her portion of food to a poor man at the door, and R. Akiva then preached that charity saves from death.
